# Variable `BBTARGETS`

## Yocto Project Reference Manual

See BBTARGETS in the BitBake manual.

## BitBake User Manual

Allows you to use a configuration file to add to the list of command-line target recipes you want to build.

Source: https://docs.yoctoproject.org/scarthgap/ref-manual/variables.html#term-BBTARGETS , https://docs.yoctoproject.org/bitbake/2.8/bitbake-user-manual/bitbake-user-manual-ref-variables.html#term-BBTARGETS
